description: Java class implementing an Akka actor (ChangeQueueActor) that manages a cache of Metadata objects, handles enqueueing changes, and provides a stream source of cache snapshots on demand.

classes.name: ChangeQueueActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that collects and forwards change metadata, providing a stream source of cache snapshots.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior for the actor.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a Metadata change into the cache.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Creates an Akka Source that emits cache snapshots at specified intervals.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Handles dump command to send current cache and reset it.

methods.name: askSelf
methods.description: Creates a Source from an ask pattern to the actor itself.
